works.work: Haklay, Orgad, Bau, Mueller, Belinkov. Position-aware Automatic Circuit Discovery. ACL 2025 (arXiv 2502.04577)
works.quote: we extend edge attribution patching, a gradient-based method for circuit discovery, to differentiate between token positions
works.relation: Method we follow in spirit: our four hand-written position classes (COND/SPEC/OPEN/DEC) are a dataset schema; the paper studies standard circuit tasks, not which algorithm a code model writes.

works.work: Nainani et al. Detecting and Characterizing Planning in Language Models (arXiv 2508.18098)
works.quote: on MBPP it switches between planning and improvisation across similar tasks and even successive token predictions
works.relation: Closest domain work (planning in code generation, Gemma-2-2B on MBPP); it detects planning but does not localise the components that compute an algorithm-choice decision token nor steer the written algorithm.

works.work: When Attribution Patching Lies: Diagnosis and a Second-Order Correction (arXiv 2606.09899)
works.quote: the dominant error stems from the non-linearities in the downstream network rather than local curvature at the patched component
works.relation: Explains why our first-order AtP screen correlates weakly with exact patching (Spearman 0.29 on random nodes for C1-forced); its HVP correction was not implemented within the 30-minute timebox, IG-AtP was used instead.

works.work: Many Circuits, One Mechanism: Input Variation and Evaluation Granularity in Circuit Discovery (arXiv 2606.06267)
works.quote: structural differences between circuits are not sufficient evidence for distinct mechanisms
works.relation: Bears on the cross-family motif comparison and on top-k stability across pair sets: a structural difference between the Qwen and Gemma circuits is not by itself a different mechanism.

works.work: Hanna, Pezzelle, Belinkov. Have Faith in Faithfulness (EAP-IG), COLM 2024 (arXiv 2403.17806)
works.quote: when using circuits to compare the mechanisms models use to solve tasks, faithfulness, not overlap, is what should be measured
works.relation: Motivates the IG-AtP fallback and the faithfulness curves reported beside overlap (Jaccard) statistics.

works.work: Differentiable Faithfulness Alignment for Cross-Model Circuit Transfer (arXiv 2604.24302)
works.quote: transfers circuit information from a smaller source model to a larger target model through a learned differentiable alignment
works.relation: Cross-model circuit comparison (Llama-3, Qwen-2.5) on factual/arithmetic tasks; our motif test is a descriptive cross-family comparison on an algorithm-choice decision, with no learned alignment.
